content_sections.heading: Shivaji College Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist -I (Non-Medical) position under the project titled "Evaluation of Self Amplifying mRNA Mediated Enzyme Replacement Therapy for the Treatment of Phenylketonuria".

content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a temporary basis, initially for three months, and may be extended till June 2027 subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: Shivaji College Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend Shivaji College Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Gather all original certificates and testimonials for verification. Make self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents. Keep proof of age and educational qualifications ready. Keep relevant experience certificates, if applicable. Report at Shivaji College, University of Delhi, Raja Garden, New Delhi - 110027 on 12 October 2026 at 10:30 a.m. in advance of the interview time for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) Original certificates and testimonials Self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents Proof of age Educational qualification certificates Relevant experience certificates, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Shivaji College Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable guidelines of ICMR, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, and the University of Delhi. Candidates should report at 10:30 a.m. in advance of the scheduled interview time for verification of their documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position announced by Shivaji College?
faq.answer: Shivaji College has announced recruitment for the Project Research Scientist -I (Non-Medical) position under an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 12 October 2026 at 11:00 a.m., with reporting time at 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Shivaji College, University of Delhi, Raja Garden, New Delhi - 110027.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduation Degree (including integrated PG Degrees) or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree (including integrated PG Degrees) with a PhD.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations of up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, Women, and Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- PM plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an updated CV, original certificates, self-attested photocopies of certificates, proof of age and educational qualifications, and relevant experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.
